description: A Customer Success Data Warehouse tracking B2C churn, B2B subscriptions, sales opportunities, support tickets, and project task logs.

Fact_Churn.description: Tracks B2C customer churn behavior, satisfaction scores, charges, and lifetime value. One row per customer churn record.

measures.Number_of_Referrals: How many friends the customer referred
measures.Tenure_Months: How long the customer has been with the company in months
measures.CLTV: Customer Lifetime Value — predicted revenue from customer
measures.Total_Revenue: Total revenue generated by this customer

Fact_Subscription.description: Tracks B2B company subscriptions including usage, billing, tenure, and churn/upgrade/downgrade events. One row per subscription.

measures.Total_users: Number of users on the subscription
measures.total_usage_time: Total time spent using the product
measures.total_errors: Total errors encountered by the subscriber

flags.is_trial: Whether the subscription is a free trial
flags.is_active: Whether the subscription is currently active

Fact_Opportunity.description: Tracks B2B sales opportunities (deals) from engagement to close. One row per opportunity.

measures.close_value: Deal value at close in USD

Fact_Ticket.description: Tracks B2B support tickets including resolution time, response time, and satisfaction. One row per ticket.

measures.resolution_time_hours: Time from ticket submission to resolution in hours
measures.first_response_time_minutes: Time to first agent response in minutes

Fact_Log.description: Tracks project task execution logs including owner, dates, sections, tags, and comments. One row per task log entry.

columns.Customer_Code: Unique business identifier for the customer
columns.Senior_Citizen: Whether the customer is a senior citizen (Yes/No)

columns.code_company: Unique business identifier for the company

Dim_Date.description: Standard date dimension used for all date foreign keys across fact tables.

columns.is_weekend: Whether date falls on a weekend

Dim_Status.description: Customer or subscription status and churn classification.

columns.Is_Closed: Whether the stage represents a closed deal
columns.Is_Won: Whether the stage represents a won deal
columns.Stage_Group: Grouped stage category (e.g. Prospecting, Negotiation, Closed)

columns.default_price: Default monthly price of the plan

Dim_Channel.description: Acquisition or marketing channels for subscriptions.

columns.channel_name: Channel name (e.g. Google Ads, Referral, Organic)
columns.is_paid: Whether the channel is paid or organic

Dim_Contract.description: Contract types for subscriptions and churn records.

columns.Contract_Type: e.g. Month-to-Month, One Year, Two Year

Dim_Offer.description: Promotional offers and payment details associated with B2C customers.

columns.Offer: Offer code applied (e.g. Offer A–E or None)
columns.Premium_Tech_Support: Whether premium tech support is included (Yes/No)
columns.Payment_Method: Payment method (e.g. Credit Card, Bank Transfer)

columns.Priority_name: Priority label (e.g. Low, Medium, High, Critical)
columns.color_code: Hex color code for UI display

Dim_Project.description: Project definitions for task log tracking.

Dim_Employee.description: Internal employees who own or work on tasks/logs.

Dim_Task.description: Task definitions used in project logs.

Dim_Section.description: Project sections or workstreams that tasks belong to.

Dim_Tag.description: Tags applied to task log entries for classification.

Dim_Comment.description: Comments attached to task log entries.

columns.full_name: Name of the person who wrote the comment

business_glossary.CLTV: Customer Lifetime Value — the predicted total revenue a customer will generate
business_glossary.Churn: When a customer or company stops their subscription or service
business_glossary.Churn_Score: A score from 0–100 indicating likelihood of churn; higher = more likely to churn
business_glossary.Churn_Category: High-level reason for churn (e.g. Competitor, Dissatisfaction, Price)
business_glossary.Tenure: How long a customer or company has been subscribed
business_glossary.Opportunity: A sales deal being tracked through the pipeline
business_glossary.Stage: The current step of a deal in the sales pipeline
business_glossary.Close_Value: The monetary value of a closed deal
business_glossary.Escalation: When a support ticket is elevated to a higher priority or tier
business_glossary.is_trial: Whether a subscription is in a free trial period
business_glossary.upgrade_flag: Whether a company upgraded their plan
business_glossary.downgrade_flag: Whether a company downgraded their plan
business_glossary.Channel: The marketing or acquisition source that brought in a subscriber
business_glossary.Resolution_Time: Hours taken to resolve a support ticket
business_glossary.Satisfaction_Score: A numeric rating given by the customer after an interaction
